verdict.text: The calibrated weights hold up out-of-sample — they separate high- from low-score band-break rates by more than the hand-set heuristic did.

method: Each weight is set in proportion to that feature's exceed-rate lift — how much more often the expected-move band breaks at the favourable end of the feature than at the unfavourable end. Lift is measured on a train split and the resulting weights are scored on a held-out test split, so the number above is out-of-sample.
